from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Define start date and holidays
start_date = datetime.strptime("2025-10-16", "%Y-%m-%d")
holidays = {
    datetime.strptime("2025-11-18", "%Y-%m-%d"),
    datetime.strptime("2025-11-26", "%Y-%m-%d"),
    datetime.strptime("2025-12-08", "%Y-%m-%d"),
    datetime.strptime("2025-12-09", "%Y-%m-%d"),
    datetime.strptime("2025-12-25", "%Y-%m-%d"),
}

# Alternative verification method: Generate list of business days and select 17th
business_days_list = []

# Keep iterating until we have 17 business days
for i in range(100):
    check_date = start_date + timedelta(days=i)
    # Business day: Monday-Friday (weekday 0-4) and not a holiday
    if check_date.weekday() < 5 and check_date not in holidays:
        business_days_list.append(check_date)
    
    # Stop once we have 17 business days
    if len(business_days_list) == 17:
        break

# Get the 17th business day (last element in list)
final_date = business_days_list[-1]

print(f"ANSWER: {final_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
